answer.summary: Both XtmHubEmailRecipientsTest failures (Platform email and Tenant email) hit the roles_guard_platform_row trigger, which refuses inserts of platform roles (tenant_id NULL) in a non-platform transaction. That trigger comes from the migration V6 Guard_roles_and_role_links this change adds, so the failure is deterministic and should repeat on re-run. The other logged errors (engine down, smtp down, database down) are expected noise from other tests and don't explain the failing build.
